outcomes.label: negative
outcomes.detail:
1 span(s) counted: We
can build it, we can staff it, and we can pay for it.
outcomes.note: exclusion (x) — a cadence-shaped tricolon defeated by its own follow-on sentence. This was pos-10 until the v1 live round, where the judge found (a) and (b) and then fired (x): "Three parallel clauses share grammatical form, but 'pay for it' adds a distinct factual claim about financial feasibility, confirmed by the next sentence referencing 'all three' as separate capabilities." That reading is right — "What we cannot do is all three" turns the members into facts the reader has to carry — so the label was wrong, not the rubric. It replaces a duller (x) case (three grade bands) that no judge would have mistaken for cadence.
